1.0: You've met all the Roly-Polies working in Eos Tower! A delightful bunch, aren't they? Are they all working hard? Thanks for taking these photos!
1.1: Okay, this is an item that you'll need to have if you want to make an item through #b#p2040022##k somewhere around Ludibrium. Please choose what kind of an item you wish to have.

yes.0: Great, great. Wait! It looks like there's something wrong with Roly-Poly 6! Can you go back and check on him again? Thanks again for all the help. Now I can focus on my own work.

npc.0: Oh, you've met all 10 Roly-Polies and took photos of them. Now just bring the photos and the camera back to #b#p2040015##k in #b#m220020300##k.

item.0: Hmmm... So you did meet up with all ten workers, but you lost the pictures along the way. You should have been careful... well there's no choice but to have to take the pictures again.

quest.0: Hmm, you haven't met with all 10 of my roly-poly workers, yet. They are all sent to Eos Tower for maintenance. I'm sure they're all working hard, but I need to have my eyes on them, though. Use the camera that I lent you to take pictures of each and every one of them, in order. Good luck!

lost.0: Oh no... Did you lose the picture you took with me? We'll have to take another one, then. Please make sure not to lose the picture this time around. Alright, here's a million-dollar pose of me working hard.

0.0: Wow, I'm just overwhelmed with all the work I have here. Lately there has been an increase in the number of monsters around Eos Tower, which means lots of places are getting destroyed right now. What's that? You're here at #b#p2040015##k's request? I see... so you need to take a picture of me. Alright, take a good picture of me working hard around here!

yes.0: You're done taking photos? Then you should return to our manager, Karl. A word of advice: Remember to return his camera with it. He adores that thing! You know where to find Karl, right? He's in #b#m220020300##k.

QuestInfo.name: Roly-Poly 10
QuestInfo.1: You got pictures of all the #bRoly-Polys#k! Return to #bManager Karl#k in #b#m220020300##k to return his camera and the photos of the Roly-Poly workers.
QuestInfo.2: I took the pictures of all 10 roly-polies working at Eos Tower and gave them to #p2040015# of the Toy Factory in Ludibrium. It looks like Roly-Poly 6 is in need of help... I should check him out.
